user.title: Install the Fire2MQTT app on your Fire TV
user.description: Fire2MQTT needs an MQTT broker (e.g. the Mosquitto broker add-on) and its companion app running on the Fire TV before Home Assistant can talk to it. Choose how to install the app — installing automatically over ADB also pushes your broker settings to the app, so you won't have to type them with a remote.

manual_install.title: Sideload the app yourself
manual_install.description:
Build the Fire2MQTT APK (or use a prebuilt release) and sideload it over ADB:
```
adb connect <fire-tv-ip>
adb install -r app-debug.apk
```

Launch the app once it's installed, then submit.

manual_grant_permissions.title: Grant permissions over ADB
manual_grant_permissions.description:
Fire OS hides Accessibility/Notification-listener toggles from sideloaded apps. Grant **`WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS`** once and the app enables them itself:
```
adb shell pm grant dev.harrypulvirenti.fire2mqtt android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
```

If this fails with `error: device offline`, your ADB-over-Wi-Fi connection went stale — run `adb disconnect <fire-tv-ip>:5555`, then `adb connect <fire-tv-ip>:5555` again, and confirm `adb devices -l` shows `device` (not `offline`) before retrying the grant command.

Submit once the grant succeeds.

manual_configure_app.title: Configure the app on your Fire TV
manual_configure_app.description:
In the Fire2MQTT app's settings screen, enter your **MQTT broker** address, an **existing broker username/password**, and a **device ID**.

The app normalizes whatever device ID you type to match Home Assistant's format (lowercase, digits, and underscores only) — check the app's on-screen topic preview and note the exact value shown, since you'll need to enter that same device ID on the next screen.

Submit once the app is configured and running.

config.title: Set up Fire TV Stick
config.description:
Enter a name and a unique device ID for your Fire TV Stick. The device ID must match the one configured in the Fire2MQTT app.

See [MQTT schema docs]({mqtt_schema_url}) for topic details.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Fire TV Stick
reconfigure.description: Change the MQTT topic prefix for device `{device_id}`. The prefix must match the one configured in the Fire2MQTT APK.

provision_adb.title: Install & configure over ADB

data_description.broker_host: IP or hostname of your Mosquitto/MQTT broker — the same broker Home Assistant's MQTT integration uses.
data_description.use_tls: Connect over TLS. Required for public/cloud brokers; uses the system trust store (self-signed certificates aren't supported yet).

error.invalid_device_id: Device ID must only contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores.
error.invalid_topic_prefix: Topic prefix may only contain letters, digits, underscores, dashes, and inner slashes (no MQTT wildcards).
error.apk_not_reachable: No response on `{status_topic}`. This almost always means the device ID or topic prefix here doesn't exactly match what you entered in the app — check for a typo or case difference against the app's topic preview. Once you've confirmed the app is running and configured correctly, check 'Continue anyway' to proceed; state will populate when it comes online.
error.adb_unreachable: Could not reach the Fire TV over ADB. Enable ADB Debugging in Developer Options and check the IP address.
error.adb_auth: The Fire TV rejected the connection. Accept the authorization dialog on the TV and try again.
error.adb_unavailable: The ADB client could not be loaded. Restart Home Assistant after the integration finishes installing its dependency.
error.install_timeout: The APK install didn't finish in time over ADB. The Fire TV may be slow or busy — try again, and keep it awake during the install.
error.signature_mismatch: The installed app was signed with a different key than this APK. Uninstall the existing app (adb uninstall dev.harrypulvirenti.fire2mqtt) and try again.
error.grant_failed: WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS could not be granted on this Fire OS build. You'll need to enable permissions manually.
error.download_failed: Could not download the APK from GitHub releases. {detail}
error.no_apk_asset: The latest GitHub release has no APK attached.

abort.mqtt_not_configured: The MQTT integration must be configured before setting up Fire2MQTT.
abort.already_configured: This device ID is already configured.

data.idle_timeout: Minutes on the home screen before reporting 'standby'

data_description.state_detection_rules_override: Optional JSON object mapping an Android package name to a python-androidtv-style rule list, e.g. {"com.netflix.ninja": [{"playing": {"media_session_state": 3}}, "idle"]}. Leave empty to use the built-in rules.

error.invalid_rules_override: The rules override must be a JSON object mapping package names to rule lists.
